scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw artifacts not feasible as the checker sandbox cannot re-run the Monte Carlo simulations; compare reported scalar/curve values against paper-digitized gold with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Edwards entropy per particle at selected densities
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from paper Figure 1: Edwards entropy curve for Kob-Andersen model
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual digitization of approximate s_edw values at given densities from the published figure
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are estimates from the published plot and represent the expected numerical outcome of the auxiliary-model simulation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Edwards temperature T_edw at density 0.848
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Figure 2: dashed line slope approximately 0.25
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read from the description of the dashed line slope in Fig. 2
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the reported approximate value from the paper.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference dynamical temperature T_dyn at density 0.848
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 2 and text stating excellent agreement with T_edw
hidden_assets.generation_method: Set equal to T_edw because the paper reports they match; approximated 0.25
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Based on the paper's conclusion that T_dyn coincides with T_edw, using the same approximate value.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Edwards structure function g_edw(r) at density ≈0.87
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual digitization; equilibrium value ρ²=0.7569; deviations are tiny; approximate values given
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Estimates from the published figure reflect the expected pair correlation function.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference dynamic structure function g_dyn(r) at density ≈0.87
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual digitization similar to Edwards structure
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Same as Edwards, representing the paper's dynamic structure function.

outputs.description: Edwards entropy per particle as a function of density. Each row: density, s_edw.
Edwards temperature at density 0.848, given as a single float.
Edwards structure function g_edw(r) at density ~0.87. Columns: r (int), g_edw (float).
Dynamic structure function g_dyn(r) at density ~0.87 from compaction. Columns: r (int), g_dyn (float).
Dynamical temperature at density 0.848, given as a single float.

output_contract.notes: The agent must run the full Monte Carlo simulations (auxiliary model annealing and dynamic compaction) to generate the raw data from which the scored quantities are derived. Intermediate process steps produce logs as evidence. Output files must adhere to the declared schemas.

steps.description: Compare agent's Edwards entropy per particle vs digitized gold curve; score based on relative error at nearest density points.
